subject: microbiology
title: Staphylococcus aureus: Identification, Coagulase and Catalase

steps.tx: **Staphylococcus aureus** is a gram positive coccus in grape like clusters, catalase positive, coagulase positive, beta haemolytic with golden pigment, fermenting mannitol on salt agar, armed by protein A, toxins and enzymes, and resident on anterior nares and skin of a third of humanity, from which most of its infections autoinoculate.
steps.say: Clusters, catalase, coagulase, gold: four words identify the genus's great pathogen.

steps.tx: The **coagulase test** splits pathogenic from commensal staphylococci: slide coagulase detects bound clumping factor (fibrinogen to fibrin on the cell), tube coagulase detects free coagulase activating prothrombin, plasma clotting in four to 24 hours. Tube test arbitrates slide negatives because some aureus strains declare only free enzyme.
steps.say: Slide screens bound, tube proves free; a negative slide still owes a tube.

left.title: Slide test
points: Latex kits detect clumping factor plus protein A

right.title: Tube test
points: Citrate using contaminants can falsify: use EDTA plasma rules

steps.tx: The **catalase test** (bubbles with peroxide) separates staphylococci from streptococci at the bench in seconds, its false positives from blood agar carryover (red cell enzyme) and old reagents teaching technique. Catalase also defends aureus against neutrophil peroxide, a bench test with a virulence footnote.
steps.say: Bubbles mean catalase; pick colonies away from blood or red cells will lie for the bacterium.

right.title: Catalase biology
points: Detoxifies hydrogen peroxide to water and oxygen
One of several oxidative burst counters

steps.tx: **Virulence architecture** stacks cell wall (protein A binding Fc backwards, capsule in some strains, teichoic acids), enzymes (coagulase walling abscesses, hyaluronidase spreading, beta lactamase), membrane toxins (alpha toxin pores, leukocidins), and superantigen toxins (next lessons). Abscess architecture itself is coagulase and host fibrin negotiating a walled city immune cells besiege poorly.
steps.say: Coagulase builds the abscess wall; protein A turns antibody backwards inside it.

left.title: Structural weapons
points: Clumping factors and fibronectin binding: adhesion

steps.tx: **Clinical empire** runs skin to sepsis: folliculitis, furuncles and carbuncles, impetigo shared with streptococci, surgical and traumatic wound infection, bacteraemia seeding endocarditis (right sided in injection drug use), septic arthritis, osteomyelitis (childhood haematogenous), pneumonia after influenza, and toxin diseases by distance. Positive blood cultures with aureus are never dismissed as contamination.
steps.say: Aureus in blood is a diagnosis, never a contaminant; hunt the source and the seedings.

steps.tx: **Carriage and control** matter epidemiologically: nasal carriage (persistent and intermittent), health care and community reservoirs, decolonisation (mupirocin and chlorhexidine in defined surgeries and outbreaks), hand hygiene as transmission's choke point, and typing (spa, whole genome) arbitrating outbreaks. Most aureus disease is endogenous, so the patient's own nose is the first suspect.
steps.say: The nose seeds the wound; decolonise the carrier before elective prostheses.

left.title: Carriage facts
points: Health care worker transmission outbreak relevant

right.title: Control tools
points: Screening in cardiac and orthopaedic pathways
Hand hygiene and device bundles (earlier module)

steps.tx: **Susceptibility identity** starts phenotypically: penicillin resistance by beta lactamase (most isolates), methicillin by mecA cefoxitin surrogate (genetics lesson), vancomycin MIC creep watched, inducible clindamycin D tested, reported by laboratory expert rules because wrong susceptible reports kill. Rapid PBP2a and mecA from positive blood cultures shorten the first day's uncertainty.
steps.say: Cefoxitin reports mecA phenotype; penicillin susceptibility now needs proof, not assumption.

nodes.label: Expert rules: D test, penicillinase checks
MSSA or MRSA therapy pathway reported

steps.tx: **Mannitol salt agar** selects staphylococci by 7.5 percent salt and differentiates aureus by mannitol fermentation turning phenol red yellow, the plate from which generations of students first met this organism. Its lesson categories (selective plus differential in one) return from the media module with a pathogen attached.
steps.say: Salt selects the genus, mannitol yellows the pathogen: one plate, two questions.

left.title: MSA design
points: Coagulase negative staph: pink, no change

right.title: MSA limits
points: Screening plates for MRSA add antibiotics (chromogenic)
Culture remains adjunct to rapid molecular in outbreaks
